dict.string: Runny uses your location to map your route and measure your distance and pace while you run.
Background location access lets Runny keep tracking your route while your screen is off or you use other apps mid-run.
Runny reads your heart rate (synced from your WHOOP band) and body weight from Apple Health to show your effort and estimate calories.
Runny saves your runs to Apple Health as workouts, including distance, calories and your GPS route.
